feeds.title: BahaiTeachings.org
feeds.description: BahaiTeachings.org helped create this platform so individuals could share their personal perspectives and insights as they strive to implement the Baha'i teachings in their everyday lives. Follow us for insightful, intelligent and inspiring Baha'i perspectives.

feeds.title: Baha'i Blog
feeds.description: Baha'i Blog is a community initiative and blog featuring Baha'i-inspired arts, media, podcasts, videos and articles. Created in Australia, and contributed to by Baha'is around the world.

feeds.title: Baha'i World News Service
feeds.description: The Baha'i World News Service is the official news source of the worldwide Bahá'í community, reports on major developments and endeavors of the global Baha'i community.

feeds.title: UK Baha'i Histories
feeds.description: The UK Baha'i Histories Project is collecting the stories of individual Baha'is who currently live in the UK, or have lived here in the past. The project is sponsored by the National Spiritual Assembly of the Baha'is of the UK. We would like to encourage everyone to write their Baha'i history.

feeds.title: Baha'i Historical Facts
feeds.description: Follow this feed to get the Baha'i Historical Facts from the survey of Baha'i history.

feeds.title: Bahá'í Recollections
feeds.description: A Bahá'í Historical Blog.

feeds.title: One Baha'i's approach...
feeds.description: One Baha'i's approach is to teach the Faith, and apply the Laws in their own life. There are many other ways to do the same thing, but this is what works and others have said that it is helpful to hear these ideas.

feeds.title: Baha'i Points of Interest
feeds.description: Baha'i Points of Interest features articles and 'Abdu'l-Baha's saying, explaining the in-depth meaning, his thoughts, words, deeds, and more.

feeds.title: Cosmic Conversations Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Alison Elizabeth Marshall. I am a follower of Baha'u'llah, the founder of the religion known as the Baha'i Faith. I write books about Bah'u'llah's mystical teachings. This blog includes thoughts about me, Baha'u'llah, my books and general issues.

feeds.title: Peter Smith
feeds.description: Publications, Lectures and Other Stuff. Peter Smith teaches courses in the History of Social Thought, the History of Psychology and Modern World History at Mahidol University International College (MUIC), a component part of Mahidol University, Thailand, where he is an Associate Professor. His PhD is in the Sociology of Religion and was completed at the University of Lancaster, England.

feeds.title: Povo de Bahá
feeds.description: News, information, comments and opinions on the Bahá'i Faith and the Baha'i Community.

feeds.title: Uplifting Words
feeds.description: Baha'i Faith inspired articles on Baha'i Holy Places, Baha'i writings, Baha'i Holy Places, Baha'i Feasts and devotionals.

feeds.title: The Bahá'i Chair for World Peace
feeds.description: The Bahá'í Chair for World Peace at the University of Maryland is an endowed academic program that advances interdisciplinary examination and discourse on global peace. While drawing certain initial insights from religion, the program aims to develop a sound scientific basis for knowledge and strategies that lead to the creation of a better world.

feeds.title: Thames Valley Bahá'í Community
feeds.description: This page is for the Thames Valley Cluster Baha'i Communities. It is to facilitate communication and to share Bahai news and photos and to announce events. Followers of the Bahai Faith, believe that all humanity is just one family. Spiritual and practical insights can be found in the Bahai Faith's teachings.

feeds.title: Baha'i Stories
feeds.description: Representing the worldwide Baha'i community to the United Nations and regional institutions. Follow our blog to get stories gleaned from Baha'i literature.

feeds.title: Baha'i Faith Harrisburg PA
feeds.description: Bahá'ís come from a wide range of ethnic and cultural backgrounds. The way of life which Bahá'ís seek to cultivate, therefore, is one that encourages personal development.

feeds.title: Bahá'í Center of Washtenaw County
feeds.description: Welcome to the Bahá'í Center of Washtenaw County!! Our focus is on spiritual and human development and a constant effort toward building greater unity among all people. Our mission is to become a spiritual center, attracting and welcoming people of all backgrounds to investigate the healing.

feeds.title: A Covenant Unique in the Spiritual Annals of Mankind
feeds.description: Get information about Baha'i by following A Covenant Unique in the Spiritual Annals of Mankind site.

feeds.title: Just a Bahai Blog
feeds.description: I am Sonja van Kerkhoff, an artist and a Bahai living in the Netherlands. I started this blog in response to being blocked from a Dutch Bahai discussion list (30th August 2009). My first blog explains what this is aboutand now I use this blog for any Bahai related stuff I write which often are responses to comments made by Bahais.

feeds.title: Wondering thoughts
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Andrew Mancey. I'm a quiet philosophical kind of guy. Into science and IT for years. Member of the Baha'i Faith. This is a blog about development, education, science, spirituality, and miscellaneous matters in Guyana and the Caribbean.

feeds.title: Baha'i Talks, Messages and Articles
feeds.description: Baha'i Talks, Messages and Articles by various authors.

feeds.title: Baha'i-Catholic Blog
feeds.description: Looking at the Baha'i Faith from a Catholic Christian perspective. I was an active, deepened Baha'i for eight years. Over time I lost my faith in Baha'u'llah, and I have since become a Christian and joined the Catholic Church. I had put my Baha'i life behind me and didn't think much about it until recently when I had some conversations with Baha'is about leaving the Faith. These conversations made me realize few things, which motivate this blog.

feeds.title: Bahá'ís of Savannah, Georgia
feeds.description: The Bahá'ís of Savannah invite you to explore the Bahá'í message with us. You are welcome to join us at the Bahá'í Unity Center. The Bahá'í Faith is an independent world religion that believes in the unity of all peoples and all religions.
